title: 义务教育教科书·英语（译林）三年级下册

sentences.cn: 博比该怎么做才能做好上学的准备？
sentences.en: What should Bobby do to get ready for school?

sentences.cn: 迈克需要什么？

sentences.en: What should Bobby do next?

sentences.cn: 博比，你可以在这里画画。
sentences.en: You can draw here, Bobby.

sentences.cn: 博比班上有哪些规矩？
sentences.en: What are the rules in Bobby’s class?

sentences.cn: 博比在课上做什么？

sentences.cn: 博比做错了什么？

sentences.en: How do Bobby and his friends have fun after class?

sentences.en: Where are Bobby’s and his friends’ paper planes?

sentences.cn: 博比觉得芒果怎么样？
sentences.en: What does Bobby think of mangoes?

sentences.en: What do Su Hai and Mike draw?

sentences.cn: 萨姆和马克斯做什么？
sentences.en: What do Sam and Max do?

sentences.cn: 博比，你有芒果吗？

sentences.cn: 妈妈，你喜欢熊吗？
sentences.en: Do you like bears, Mum?

sentences.cn: 妈妈，我可以买个气球吗？
sentences.en: Can I buy a balloon, Mum?

sentences.cn: 蒂娜买了哪个气球？
sentences.en: Which balloon does Tina buy?

sentences.cn: 博比可能会买哪个气球？
sentences.en: Which balloon may Bobby buy?
